title: BTR craft
description: A vanilla experience but with a few tweaks !!!
body:
# **BTR Craft**
BTR Craft is a modpack which contains many quality of life mods, optimisation mods, client sided mods but also some server sided. This modpack contains only vanilla+ enhancement without adding anything crazy new to the game, perfect if you just want the vanilla experience but with tweaks !

## **BUT WHY ???**
Because my friends kept asking me for my mods and i didn't want to go through the struggle everytime to export the modpack, send it, troubleshoot, etc. So i made this modpack :)
